failure_modes: Assuming shared context that the agent lacks
Over-specifying so the agent has no room for judgment
gloss: Brief an agent like a capable outsider who has never seen your company
invariants: Capabilities and blind spots are both assumed
mechanism: Delegated work fails when tasks are dropped over the fence. The brief instead supplies everything a talented freelancer with no context would need: goal, background, constraints, and what good looks like. Agents are highly capable in some areas and oblivious in others, the same as new hires.
